name: Tracy Ifeachor
bio:
Tracy Ifeachor (born 13 February 1985) is a British television and theatre actress. She is best known for playing the role of Aya Al-Rashid in The CW vampire series The Originals, and Abigail Naismith in the Doctor Who Christmas special, "The End of Time". She plays the main role of duty solicitor Cleo Roberts in the 2021 BBC drama, Showtrial. She stars as Dr. Heather Collins in the 2025 Max's The Pitt.
